workflow: A runtime allows an object with fixed-size contiguous storage to replace its type metadata without verifying that the new type has a compatible length, element representation, and
The object retains its original backing allocation while later operations interpret it using the replacement type’s layout.
A subsequent indexed assignment or bulk write computes offsets from the incompatible layout and writes beyond the allocated storage.
Memory-safety instrumentation detects the heap overflow and terminates the process instead of rejecting the incompatible type change.
summary: Unchecked type replacement causes later layout-based heap overflow
